quotes.text: My experience with Golden State Sportfishing was amazing, these guys put me on the fish and the action was on stop, I mean red hot! We were hooking into and landing monster sturgeon all day long when nobody else around us was catching anything. These guys are true professionals and very good at what they do. If you want a truly amazing fishing experience book a trip today. You won’t be disappointed. Highly recommended

This is the most fun, exciting fishing experience! I have been fishing on this charter many times and Capitan Joe never disappoints. He is very knowledgeable and safe. We have had many great stories from catching a great white, saving a man from the water and lots of laughs and great catches. He always puts us on fish and we catch limits. You will not be disappointed when you book with Golden State Sportfishing!!!

Very impressed with Captains knowledge and experience! This is a highly skill charter that has guided me to three of my new personal best fish! Halibut, Striper, and Sturgeon. Few years back salmon as well. Get on the books and fasten your seat belt stop dreaming and get on that trophy catch with Golden State Sportfishing! Looking forward to our shark trip Golden State Sportfishing!!!

What an extraordinary trip. My first time in the SFO bay fishing and I can not express how Joey was patiently working with me and how much fun the entire crew was! I highly recommend planning a trip - a great family thing to do and with friends. I will definitely be back on another trip! I caught two halibuts and two striped sea bass! Thank you so much for the great adventure!
